content.title: Shrinking Season 3: How Many Episodes Are Going To Be There In the Apple TV Show? - IMDb
content.text: Shrinking Season 3: How Many Episodes Are Going To Be There In the Apple TV Show?Apple TV+ has officially announced that Season 3 of Shrinking will consist of 11 episodes. This is one episode less than the second season and one episode more than the debut season. Created by Bill Lawrence, Jason Segel, and Brett Goldstein, each episode will be approximately 30 to 45 minutes long.Blending comedy with introspection and therapeutic honesty, the season will kick off with a special one-hour premiere episode, giving viewers a more immersive start before settling into the regular episode rhythm.
